plain_description.what: Repeats the GAP-FIX test (a few nearest-centroid passes on the tree's leaves, then compare with a flat mixture) on three fresh content-closed trees and on trees built with a second embedding model. No judge calls.
plain_description.why: GAP-FIX found the gap only partly closed on one tree, mostly by re-centring; the follow-up it named is content-closed re-draws and a second embedder.
plain_description.information: Shows whether a few rounds of re-assigning items within each parent branch close the gap between the tree's leaves and a flat clustering with the same number of groups. Result: done. On all three new content-closed trees the gap shrinks but stays (about 2 percentage points of purity, clearly below zero), so the refinement does not close it; whether it is a large or a moderate gap cannot be told apart at this sample size. A second embedder gives the same picture on 2 of 3 trees.
